harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1's render launcher. It now locates its helper and template relative to its installed directory, runs with only PATH=/usr/bin:/bin from any working directory, writes the requested output, and preserves the complete report. The source template, RHEL release, and kernel remain unchanged. Restart persistence was verified.
actions_performed: Replaced only bin/render with a location-aware POSIX shell launcher.
Verified rendering from /, /tmp, and /var/tmp using an otherwise empty environment.
Confirmed absolute and relative output paths contain the full expected report.
Preserved the source template with SHA-256 60a2035d67e51a10515562d314f64c88029a1f2e78a15c24ae719ebdf1c28a03.
Safely restarted node1 and verified recovery and persistence.

evidence.requirement: Render works in the minimal batch environment from any working directory
evidence.summary: Captured the original failure, installed the corrected launcher, and proved successful executions from / and /tmp with env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin.

evidence.requirement: Helper and template are found, requested output is written, and report contents are retained
evidence.summary: Absolute and relative output files were created and byte-compared against the expected 41-byte report containing its heading, region, and shipment count.

evidence.requirement: Source template, operating-system release, and kernel are preserved
evidence.summary: The template checksum remained identical before and after repair/restart; RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 were unchanged.

Healthy pre-restart render and boot ID f455a75c-ec12-49a8-a647-c2be3f67c08c were captured; restart acknowledgement returned; the new boot ID d87c5deb-286e-4425-b5fb-334b5738818e proved a node restart; system state and minimal-environment rendering recovered successfully.
